data.title_bangla: Signing Ceremony upay and UCB Investment Limited

segment one.title: উপায় and UCB Investment Limited Sign Agreement for Corporate Payout Solution
segment one.title bn: উপায় and UCB Investment Limited Sign Agreement for Corporate Payout Solution
segment one.desc:
upay and UCB Investment Limited have signed an agreement to introduce a comprehensive corporate payout solution, marking a significant step toward enhancing digital financial operations and payment efficiency.

The signing ceremony was attended by Mr. Tanzim Alamgir, Managing Director & CEO of UCB Investment Limited and Mr. Shaymol B. Das, Chief Executive Officer of upay.

The signing ceremony was also attended by H.A. Fattah  - Senior Manager, Anisul Haque - VP & Senior Manager from UCB Investment Limited and Sajjad Alam - Head of Corporate Sales and Md. Mamunur Rashid - Manager, Corporate Sales from upay; along with other officials from both organizations.

Through this collaboration, upay will facilitate a secure, seamless, and efficient digital payout mechanism for UCB Investment Limited, covering a wide range of organizational payments and other operational expenses, in addition to regular payroll disbursements.
